name_zh: 本-古里安/以色列/建国/锡安主义/战争/内盖夫/核/本-古里安
description_zh: 本-古里安 (1886-1973) 是以色列首任总理和国父，领导以色列建国和国防建设，推行锡安主义建国，领导内战和独立战争，建立内盖夫定居点，推动核计划（DIMONA），提出内盖夫梦想（色列的内盖夫是希望之地）。
description_en: David Ben-Gurion (1886-1973) was the first Prime Minister and founding father of Israel, leading state-building and defense, implementing Zionist state-building, leading civil war and independence war, establishing Inner Valley settlements, promoting nuclear program (DIMONA), proposing Inner Valley dream (Israel's Inner Valley is land of hope).
reason_zh: 核心思维：M534(锡安主义建国/内盖夫梦想/核模糊/本-古里安主义)、1(战略预判)、67(战略敏捷)、37(知行合一)、153(儒商传承/民族建设)。本-古里安体现了战略预判和知行合一的精神，通过锡安主义建国实现民族复兴，将内盖夫视为希望之地，通过核模糊实现战略威慑，通过部落联盟建立现代国家。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M534(Zionist State-Building/Inner Valley Dream/Nuclear Ambiguity/Ben-Gurionism)、1(Strategic Foresight)、67(Strategic Agility)、37(Know-Act Integration)、153(Ju-Shang Inheritance/Nation Building)。Ben-Gurion embodies strategic foresight and know-act integration spirit through Zionist state-building achieving national revival, positioning Inner Valley as land of hope, nuclear ambiguity strategic deterrence, tribal alliance modern nation-building.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定建国大计：制定锡安主义建国计划，建立内盖夫定居点
第2步：战略敏捷法——灵活建国：通过政治活动建国，通过军事行动捍卫国家
第3步：知行合一——实施建国战略：通过政治努力和建国实践实现国家建设
第4步：儒商传承——民族建设：继承民族智慧，建设现代国家
第5步：长期主义——维护国家：确保以色列的长期发展和安全
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate national plan: Formulate Zionist state-building plan, establish Inner Valley settlements
Step 2: Strategic Agility - Flexible state-building: Promote nation through political activities, defend nation through military actions
Step 3: Know-Act Integration - Implement state-building strategy: Realize nation-building through political efforts and state-building practice
Step 4: Ju-Shang Inheritance - National construction: Inherit national wisdom, build modern nation
Step 5: Long-termism - Maintain nation: Ensure Israel's long-term development and security
expected_zh: 建立现代以色列国家，实现锡安主义建国
建立强大的国防体系，确保国家安全
推动犹太民族的复兴和民族复兴
expected_en: Establish modern State of Israel, realize Zionist dream
Build strong defense system, ensure national security
Promote Jewish national revival and national renaissance
case_zh: 1886 出生；1948 建国；1973 逝世；内战/核计划。锡安主义建国/内盖夫梦想/核模糊范式永存。
case_en: 1886 birth; 1948 state-building; 1973 death; civil war/nuclear program. Zionist state-building/Inner Valley dream/nuclear ambiguity paradigm endures.
